title: Every AI answer costs electricity

scenes.say: Behind every reply, powerful chips in a data centre are doing the work.
scenes.caption: Behind every reply, powerful chips in a data centre are doing the work.

scenes.say: The I.E.A. expects global data centre electricity use to more than double by twenty thirty.
scenes.caption: The IEA expects global data centre electricity use to more than double by 2030.

scenes.say: And power use by A.I.-focused servers is projected to grow about thirty percent a year.
scenes.caption: Power use by AI-focused servers is projected to grow about 30% a year.

scenes.say: India is building its own A.I. computing capacity, fast.
scenes.caption: India is building its own AI computing capacity, fast.

scenes.say: Each new generation of chips does more work for every unit of energy.
scenes.caption: Each new generation of chips does more work for every unit of energy.

scenes.say: Smaller, smarter models can answer many questions with far less computing.
scenes.caption: Smaller, smarter models can answer many questions with far less computing.

scenes.say: And when data centres run on clean power, every answer gets cleaner.
scenes.caption: And when data centres run on clean power, every answer gets cleaner.

scenes.say: With India's solar and wind growing fast, A.I. can grow green.
scenes.caption: With India's solar and wind growing fast, AI can grow green.

scenes.say: Follow The Green Solve for more.
scenes.caption: Follow The Green Solve

sources: IEA, Energy and AI (2025): data centre electricity ~415 TWh (2024) to ~945 TWh (2030); accelerated-server electricity use growing ~30% a year (base case)
